title: Stalks of cohomology sheaves
statement:
For $Q\in D(T_{\Et})$ and a geometric point $\bar t$ of $T$,

$$
\mathcal H^q(Q)_{\bar t}=\mathcal H^q(Q_{\bar t}),
$$

where $Q_{\bar t}$ denotes the pullback of $Q$ to the point.

proof.text: Put F = Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat t, the inverse image of def-weil-pbc-inverse-image. Its existing additive, finite-limit-preserving and finite-colimit-preserving instances make it exact. The proved library comparison CategoryTheory.Functor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, applied to F and q, gives F(H^q(Q)) isomorphic to H^q(F.mapDerivedCategory(Q)). This comparison already works on the unbounded derived categories of def-weil-pbc-derived-categories: preservation of homology of complexes and localization are built into the proved generic construction.

Let S be the universe-lifted sheaf fibre at the identity geometric point of Spec Omega. Apply Etale.upperStarCompUliftSheafFiberIso from lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar to t and the identity geometric point. Simplifying identity followed by t gives the natural isomorphism F followed by S isomorphic to the universe-lifted sheaf fibre at t. Evaluate it at H^q(Q) and invert it.

Apply S.mapIso to the component at Q of the comparison in step 1. Compose the inverse stalk comparison of step 2 with this image. Its source is the geometric stalk of H^q(Q) at t and its target is S(H^q(F.mapDerivedCategory(Q))), exactly the two objects in nonempty_geometricStalk_cohomology_iso. Wrap the composite in Nonempty. No boundedness or exactness of S is needed in this route.
